summary: Failed replication tasks become permanently inaccessible in the DLQ when source and target clusters have different shard counts. Tasks are written using the local shard ID but retrieved using a different shard ID mapping, causing a key mismatch that silently loses data.
userImpact: Users running multi-cluster replication with different shard counts experience silent, permanent loss of failed replication tasks with no error logging or visibility.
rootCause: convertTaskToDLQTask() writes DLQ entries using local shard ID (p.shard.GetShardID()), but GetDLQReplicationMessages retrieves them using target cluster's shard ID mapping (config.GetShardID()). When source/target shard counts differ, the keys diverge, making tasks unretrievable.
proposedFix: Use common.MapShardID to determine correct target shard IDs when writing to DLQ, ensuring consistency with how GetDLQReplicationMessages retrieves them (similar to fix in PR #10226).
keyQuote: No error is logged — silent data loss under cross-shard replication
